name: comments
description: Workspace-scoped threaded comments anchored to pages or blocks. Soft-delete + resolve semantics. useComments(opts) hook returns items + openCount + CRUD mutations.
notes: Page-level comments leave blockId undefined; block-anchored comments set blockId. resolvedAt!=null = thread closed but visible. UI components deferred (notion-coupled to PageCommentsContext). Consumer authors panels. Original `comments` → namespaced `comments_threads`.
